input:
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P0] 【孟子】小的时候
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 (first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is)
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧出生以后 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (loose_clause_connection): ⟦孟子是孩子⟧ — her note: no logic relationship with the preceding or following sentences
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card loose_clause_connection: Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.

[P1] 孟子和他的朋友喜欢【玩在墓地里】
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子和他的朋友喜欢[玩在墓地里→在墓地里玩] (location should come before the verb 玩)
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子和他的朋友喜欢[-玩]在墓地里
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 孟子和他的朋友喜欢[玩在墓地里→在墓地里玩] (在 + Place comes before the action: 在Place + V.)
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里[+玩]
  her past correction (loose_clause_connection): ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction (no_le_routine_state): 孟子一直跟他的朋友⟦去了⟧墓地祭拜 — her note: no了for routine/habit
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 孟子跟朋友[看→看到]很多的大人在墓地祭拜 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.
  rule card loose_clause_connection: Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.

[P2] 【装】祭拜
  proposed by the AI checker: [装→装作]祭拜 (装作 is needed before a verb phrase)
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): [+就]开始祭拜 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  her past correction (verb_object_valency): 在墓地[-做]祭拜
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 而是[-他]祭拜
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.
  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself. Not an error: Do not flag 掉 when it is a resultative complement after another main action verb. 掉 can also be used in the structure 掉 + directional + place.

[P3] 孟子五岁【的】时候
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 孟子五岁[-的]时候 (Num. + MW. + N., no 的)
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-有一天]孟子才四岁
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 孟子才三岁[+就]开始搬家 — her note: 才Num.就V.
  rule card numeral_measure_word_order: With a number and measure word, use Num. + MW. + noun directly, with no 的. For actions, use V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.; for a completed action, use 了completed, V. + Num. + MW. + Obj. Not an error: Do not use 们 or 些 with a number: use 三个男孩, not 三个男孩子们, and 那三个男孩, not 那些三个男孩.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.

[P4] 跟妈妈搬家【^】
  proposed by the correction model: 跟妈妈搬家[+了]
  her past correction (redundant_words): 跟孟母[-一起]搬家三次
  her past correction (numeral_measure_word_order): 跟孟母一起[搬家三次→搬了三次家] — her note: 了completed，V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): [+就]跟孟母一起搬家三次 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card numeral_measure_word_order: With a number and measure word, use Num. + MW. + noun directly, with no 的. For actions, use V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.; for a completed action, use 了completed, V. + Num. + MW. + Obj. Not an error: Do not use 们 or 些 with a number: use 三个男孩, not 三个男孩子们, and 那三个男孩, not 那些三个男孩.

[P5] 而是【因为】妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近
  proposed by the correction model: 而是[-因为]妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 他的妈妈[不想跟他的朋友去墓地→不想让他跟朋友去墓地] — her note: otherwise it means his mother didn’t want to go with his friend to the graveyard.
  her past correction (location_with_zai): 孟子和他的妈妈住在离墓地很近[+的地方] — her note: 住在+Place
  her past correction (specific_noun_choice): 妈妈认为他们[拿东西→拿了墓地的东西] — her note: “东西” is too general and vague
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.

places.reason: First mention needs an identifying noun phrase.
装作 is needed before a verb phrase.
五岁的时候 does not take 的.
The completed-event 了 is optional here.
不是因为……而是因为…… is a valid paired structure.
